stem: Which statement is an accurate comparison of the formula for ammonia (NH₃) and the formula for sodium hydroxide (NaOH)?

options.label: A
options.text: The formula for sodium hydroxide has more atoms and more elements than the formula for ammonia.

options.label: B
options.text: The formula for ammonia has more atoms and more elements than the formula for sodium hydroxide.

options.label: C
options.text: The formula for sodium hydroxide has more atoms, but the formula for ammonia has more elements.

options.label: D
options.text: The formula for ammonia has more atoms, but the formula for sodium hydroxide has more elements.
